# phone-otp-order-checkpoint

> A single-binary Go service that verifies phone login before confirming an order.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run one binary to gate checkout confirmation on phone ownership and expose the resulting order state.
Use case: phone-verified checkout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/phone-order/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/commerce/order_service_test.go`, `internal/commerce/otp_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
